description: `<helper/>` mounts an imported name whose source export is a `function`, not an engine. Per §51.0.D the cross-file mount form requires an engine binding, so E-ENGINE-MOUNT-NOT-ENGINE fires (§34: Error). Uses the `files` multi-file convention — `lib.scrml` is the aux import fixture.
rationale: §51.0.D + §21.8 — a self-closing `<EngineName/>` tag is the CROSS-FILE ENGINE MOUNT form: it mounts the singleton of an exported `<engine>` declaration. When the imported name resolves to some other export kind, the tag is not a mount at all, and silently forwarding it as an unknown HTML element would leave the author with a page that renders nothing and reports nothing.
